Heres a list of chemicals that are usefull to have when attempting to be reliant and still have a manageable outfit. Most of these chemicals can be acquired in a concentrated form.

Bleach: needs to be stored upright. One does not simply put bleach in a leak proof bottle. It gases off with light present, seals have never stood up to bleach. Once i used a small mister bottle with diluted bleach for water purifying while hiking but the seals didnt stand up and i probably drank part of them. The smallest bleach bottle that come with a handle is more expedient than the smaller version with no handle imo.

Phenol: Normal phenol throat spray is used for dermal issues, cleaning the nose when it feels sick(qtip around just inside nostril), sterilizing cuts in a more permeating fashion than h2o2. Dont use on the gums and inside mouth much because it is acidic and will receed a gumline.

H2o2: dilute for mouthwash, clean cuts. Its more compact than mouthwash and is the goto for dental rinse.

Baking soda: for incindental odors, cleaning tent floors, makeshift toothpaste i guess. Great shower additive.

Washing soda: for laundry in combination with soap and bleach. It can be put into shower water to cut down on rinse water needed and soap needed. A liter of water can make a fine shower with a couple drops of bleach and a head to toe washing technique

Good soap: plant based lacks the waxes and tannins animal derived soap has. Kirks coconut castile ftw. This can serve as laundry soap as well

Vasiline: mainly for fire starting in combination with cotton. The cotton could be kept seperate. Jelly cotton firestarters can be prepared heterogeneously or homogeneously. Either work great. But homogeneously prepared firestarters would be water proof more or less. Oiling pruners etc

Denatured alcohol/ethanol: its like 7-8times more expensive per btu than propane about, more dangerous to heat with than any other fuel. It is though very clean burning and the only real viable solution to 3person and smaller expedition packs. If you keep isobutane for your bug out kit you are a fag because those cans dont endure refills/price/availablity like theyd need to. 1lb propane can be filled at home from a cheap and plentifull 20lb or what not. But anyway back to ethanol,, great cleaner. great fuel. expensive. Low btu/volume.

Propane: 1lb tanks van be refilled but their valves can wear an the tank become leaky and unuseable after time. If you wanna haul it on your back put a foam mat around the tank. The cheap propane hoses chip on the inside ive heard and clog units. This is why mr heater requests a "fuelfilter" with off brand hoses.

Water: 6gal jerry cans are indispensable. Going to the waterpoint unnessicarly is a time suck.
Chemicals: essentials, techniques, notes of disapproval
